summary.intent: Find out what is present locally in the repo (commits, staged and unstaged changes) and whether any of it is worth pushing to the remote.
summary.outcome: Identified one local commit (f5ead0d, implementation-context schema) plus staged Smith integration as worth pushing together, with `just check` passing (49 tests). Flagged the unstaged repo rename changes as a separate commit and the Entire/Gemini hook changes as needing review. Current remote tips could not be verified because github.com did not resolve.

repo: Branch docs/ecosystem-changelog-catchup is 1 commit ahead of its tracked remote, but the remote ref was last updated locally on September 27, so 'ahead 1' may be stale.
`just check` validates the manifest, version, generated bundle (Codex), and documentation checks, and runs 49 tests.

The Codex distribution under dist/codex is generated from harnesses/codex and shared schemas, so schema or skill changes appear in both places (e.g. implementation-context@1.json in mason and smith, smith SKILL.md).
The repo is being renamed from agent-plugins to wisp-plugins, which touches docs, READMEs, manifests, and the issue template config.
Local changes fall into three groups: the committed schema, staged Smith integration, and unstaged rename plus hook/settings updates.
Untracked __pycache__ files are test artifacts and should not be pushed.
The release/v4.4.0 branch has 2 local commits and has diverged from its tracked remote.

code.finding: Changes enable automatic checkpoint and session pushes, which affects every local session and needs review before pushing.
Changes remove the existing hooks, which needs review before pushing.

workflow: Sort mixed working-tree changes by topic (committed, staged, unstaged) and recommend separate commits for unrelated groups.
Run the repository's checks (`just check`) before recommending a push.
A local remote-tracking ref can be stale; verify the actual remote tip before treating ahead/behind counts as authoritative.
Hook and settings changes deserve extra scrutiny since they affect all local sessions.

friction: github.com did not resolve in the environment, so current remote tips could not be verified.
The tracked remote ref was last updated September 27, so ahead/behind counts may be out of date.
release/v4.4.0 has diverged from its tracked remote, complicating any push of that branch.
open_items: Commit the staged Smith integration and push it together with f5ead0d once the remote state is verified.
Commit the agent-plugins to wisp-plugins rename links as a separate commit.
Review the Entire hook changes (.entire/settings.json) and Gemini hook removal (.gemini/settings.json) before committing or pushing.
Resolve the divergence on release/v4.4.0 relative to its tracked remote.
Re-check remote tips once network access to github.com is available.
